_why: The SDK source tree uses uv-dynamic-versioning (pyproject.toml:5-6) and the read clone carries no git tags, so it cannot state its own version. `pydantic-ai-slim==2.35.0` in requirements.txt is a LABEL; these digests are the assertion. Review proved the distinction mattered: with only the version pin in place, external.py could be edited and all 18 gates still passed.
_algorithm: sha256 of the file bytes, as installed under site-packages/pydantic_ai/
